text: Super Unique & Sassy This dress was great, very unique! The long sleeves were great for the crisp Spring weather. The only problem I had was that the dress kept creeping up, so I spent a lot of the evening pulling it down or trying to conspicuously hold it in place.  I got quite a bit of compliments and was comfortable (minus the traveling hem).

Sparkly like a trophy! I rented this dress for my halloween costume as the NHL Stanley Cup! It was perfect for the costume and I got compliments all night. The dress was comfortable and easy. I wore the XS which was my backup size as it ran a little large.

Elegant, classic A fitted sheath, there is no stretch, and you won't be able to hide anything. Having said that, get a back up size that is bigger, and you should be fine. I had many compliments on the dress, and it was beautiful. Did not ride up, and had no issues with the lace as some other reviewers did. You need a lower riding strapless bra (or adhesive). Length was great for a tall girl. Wore this to host my sister's baby shower, and proved to be comfortable while moving around quite a bit.

I wore this to a West Point banquet and got so many compliments! I absolutely loved it. It was VERY long. I am 5'4 and had to wear 5 inch heels and it STILL was dragging on the floor. The color is a true red, and the fit is a little bit big. I ended up wearing a size 4. I loved this dress so much and got so many compliments, and a family friend who regularly attends military balls even said she was going to try and find it for her event!

Beautiful Dress! Unfortunately, I was somewhere in between 8 and 10 size. I ended up wearing the 10R - which was too long in the torso (had about 2 inches of room in the straps - and I have broad shoulders!). But the 8R was too tight in the upper back - I have a swimmers body. Over all length of the dress was perfect - I would walk in 2.5" heels, and when I stood still, the dress fell nicely to the floor.
Customer service was AMAZING. When the first two sizes arrived and neither fit, I called in and they shipping out 2 more sizes the very next day. All returns were confirmed via email and I would rate just customer service a 5-star. The fit is was downgraded my rating.
All eyes popped when I walked in wearing the dress - it's absolutely breathtaking. It's one that I highly recommend - just order early in case the size you think you need does not fit.

Watching my hubby win an award.  The dress runs a bit big, especially up top. Since I'm relatively flat-chested, I felt like I could have used a more flattering fit in that department. In any case, the dress was lovely, very comfortable (loved the pockets), and I received compliments from strangers all night long. There was nothing else like it being worn in the ballroom.
easy dress! loose fit - great to hide my baby bump

I felt so pretty in this dress!  It's a bit short and I'm so glad I got 2 sizes. I'm usually a size 0 and the 2 fit better. The colors are amazing in person and this dress fits you body in all the right ways! I say it's a must rent if you like to be a show stopper! ;)
Great fit!  Comfortable dress! Loved this dress!  I wore to work with a jean jacket.  I received many compliments!

Great dress, great cut, great material, great color. This dress was great. The only caveat is that it really runs small - I normally wear a 6 but went for an 8 because I was wearing it for work and I wanted to err on the side of loose.  I could barely get the zipper up past my ribs (no bra). The bottom wasn't tight and the length was great.  I just would have gone for a 10 next time!
the back is amazing! the zipper catches and is super weak

Wasn't able to wear The dress was much shorter than it appeared, too short for a wedding, so I wasn't able to wear it.  Other reviews about the lace being a little tight on the shoulders is spot-on, but it would have been fine if the dress had been a little longer.  Bummer, too, because it is such a pretty dress.

Loved the overall look of the dress. Classy, but modern and fun! The dress ran a little bit on the small side and was very long (although I'm pretty short at 5' but was wearing 4 inch heels). The way the dress draped when it hit the floor was perfect though. The material was comfortable, but not very forgiving- I wore no-show panties that still showed a little! Overall a great dress.

Perfect for a spring wedding! Wore this dress for a BTO spring wedding in early May. I had ordered this in a 6 and an 8, but RTR informed me they'd only be sending me the 8 due to the 6 coming back damaged. I think the dress runs a little small (mainly chest/arms/length), I almost always wear a 6 but the 8 fit perfectly. Great for shorter girls since I'm only 5'2 and the length was perfect on me. The fabric is somewhat stretchy and super comfortable for dancing, but came a little wrinkled in the bag and didn't really flatten out with an iron. Still would definitely rent again in another color!

Absolutely perfect.  I wore this as my reception dress and couldn't have asked for a better one.  I probably could have worn the 0.  As you can see, I got the 2 and the 4 and my mom, usually a 6/8 fit into the 4.  But, the shape of the dress made it so it didn't look big or frumpy.
This was a great dress that really held everything in.  I thought it was going to be a nude underlay, however it was more gray.

Beautiful Dress! I wear a 4 normally and went for a 2, based on other reviews which was accurate.  The dress is gorgeous and very well made.  Piping of the same material makes for beautiful finishing.  Love the pockets and slight stretch.

Worn to a company holiday party Lots of compliments.  0 was a little tight across the upper back.  2 was perfect.
(note that it had a small hole in the lace in the front - wasn't too noticeable though)

Perfect Wedding Dress This dress was a beautiful color and cut. I read the other reviews, which suggested to size up, so instead of ordering 2/4, I ordered 4/6. I wound up wearing the 6 because the 4 was just way too tight. Even the 6 was a little tight, but I think the 8 would have been a little too loose. I loved the dress itself and felt that it was perfect for a cocktail attire wedding. I have wide hips, so for anyone thinking of ordering this dress with wide hips, I would definitely keep that in mind and size up 1-2 sizes.

Great summer wedding dress! The fit was a little big and I wore the 0, but mostly in the bust. I just wore a structured bra and it looked great! It was perfect for my sister-in-law's wedding day in Texas. Great to dance in, super comfy, and pockets! I would definitely recommend renting this dress. Though the photo from the wedding is in black and white, it was the perfect pop of color for summer.

One of a kind! I LOVE LOVE LOVE this dress! I wore it to a charity gala on a cold night. The dress is warm enough that I didn't need to worry about a jacket (Caution: If you're dancing, you might get hot!).
I was worried that the sequins would be itchy or scratch my skin near the edges of the dress. They didn't.
I was worried that I'd be constantly tugging at the back to keep covered, but it stayed in place perfectly.
I am 5'2" and could have worn with flats. I chose heels but wished the dress had been about half an inch longer. My stomach is definitely my problem area, but I didn't need spanx to wear this dress.
I got so many compliments on this dress!

Swallowed me whole The dress was not flattering for me. I'm averagely tall and skinny but it made me look much bigger than I am. I would possibly wear it on vacation to the beach maybe but not for anyone to see me in. I don't know if it as the wide straps that did it the overall cut of the dress. I typically like these silhouettes but this one was not the same.

Airy, lovely dress for a vineyard wedding! I loved the feel and lightness of this dress! I am short, so it was full length on me, but still looked great. I ordered the 4 and the 2, but wish I had the 0 since the top was a tick too loose for my liking. I swapped the belt for one I already own to break up the patten a little bit. Great dress!
Great Dress Received so many compliments on this dress!  It was comfy, fit true to size, and worked out great for a wedding!

Great dress- be careful of the length This dress is beautiful and flattering.  I am small in the chest, so I think I should have sized down from my usual 2 to a 0.  Additionally, based on the length size chart, I should have needed a Long dress based on my height in heels.  However, the Long was REALLY long and I could not wear the dress without tripping over it.  In retrospect, I wish I had ordered my backup size in the Regular length.  Lesson learned.  Thankfully, RTR was very cool and gave me credit for the dress since I could not wear it due to the length.

runs really big! I'm a solid 8 in most RTR/designer clothing and was swimming in the 6.  SIZE DOWN.  I also tried the blush pink version in an 8 recently and didn't make the connection it was the same design - but had I remembered I would have ordered the 4.  Beyond size issues, though, it's a lovely little romper. Cool, comfy fabric that still has a bit of a dressed up look.  The neckline has a lace-like detail -- it's hard to see from the photos but it's not sparkly/shiny as it might appear.  I'd rent again, but in the correct size...

Wore for everyday :)  This dress is super comfy and intentionally cut on the larger side.  I liked the draping and the dress was beautifully made.  It did sit quite low on my chest (since I'm small chested) but fine for the weekend and running errands, shopping, etc.

Georgeous dress that fit me perfectly! I absolutely loved this dress! I wore it for a work event with a masquerade theme, and I've never received so many compliments. It fit my hourglass frame perfectly--the waist is very fitted and flattering, and there was also room in the hips and bust.

Great piece!  Cool details.  Versatile. I've rented this twice, because once just wasn't enough!  Great details, comfy.  Good condition - no scuffs or scratches.  Fits nice, but a tiny bit larger than the size.  Love it with jeans!

Beautiful but runs a bit small The fabric, the design, quality, adaptability to different situations/events are all great with this top. It is memorable, and elegant. The issue, however, is that it does run small, particularly in the chest area.
Lovely Fall wedding I liked this dress, think I needed the size up because it fits slimmer through the hips.
Simple and perfect! Wore this for my bridal shower, it fit 100% perfectly. Was comfortable for 11 hours and it kept me looking simple with room for some louder accessories.

This dress was everything I hoped for and more. I felt amazing. THANK YOU. I was worried about the size bc I looked at the review for the same dress only short and they said it ran small in the arms. And it was literally perfect.
Did not sut well. Looks better on the model. Fabric good quality. For some reason it runs very big.

Beautiful color...comfortable fit.  The dress is an absolutely beautiful blue. If it wasn't such a vibrant color I don't think I would have worn it due to it being a bit loose. I am usually between a 0 and a 2 (xs/s) and I wore the XS which was still a bit big. However it gave me room to eat and drink whatever I wanted! Worth the rent!

Lovely dress fit perfectly - tight bodice (if you are full-chested you would not want to rent this dress), with slightly flared skirt that comes below the knee (and I am tall).  This is a beautiful dress - well made and with the lovely detail of the pearls midway down the skirt.  I would rent it again.

Beautiful dress, I received compliments all night! This dress was the right combination of sexy and sophisticated, The open back was my favorite part. The high low worked well with me being tall and wearing heals, I do not know how well it would work with shorter women. I felt very glamorous as the fabric is thick and of high quality, and hello it has pockets! Everyone wanted to know where I got it, highly recommend this dress!

The dress is wonderful and fits like a glove!  I wore it to my birthday party and everyone loved it! The dress fits great, and I felt very comfortably in it all night!  The lacy back was very figure flattering and my friends loved it!!

A beautiful dress for a wedding guest I received a backup design since my first choice was unavailable. I normally wear a 14 but went with the 16 based on the reviews. I experienced the same issues as some of the other girls here. The ribcage was tight but the area right below the neckline kind of bubbled up in a weird way like there was extra material. There is no stretch to this dress at all so definitely size up from your regular size. It did fall beautifully and it seems to be constructed from high quality material. The high low cut was just right for me at 5’3”. The pockets were my favorite part of course! Overall, a great rental.

Perfect causal brunch look Fits true to size. I wore this to brunch with friends then ran some errands after. The only issue I had was that I had to be careful with my arm movements. The sleeves would rise up over my shoulders when I moved my arms over my head. Great for brunch; not great for grocery shopping.

I got so many compliments and the twirl factor is a 10/10 I typically wear a 12, but 14W was the only size available when I reserved my dress.  Thankfully, I wasn't able to order the 12W because I would have been out an outfit.  The 14W was a tad tight in the bust and right at the waist and I think I would have been much more comfortable in a 16W.  Despite the tight fit, I received so many compliments that night.  I don't normally dance at weddings, but it was so much fun twirling around in that dress, my friend and I couldn't stay off the dance floor.

Classic Ran a bit small in my opinion. I ordered the 4 and a 6 as the backup, ended up wearing the 6. The zipper is a bit tricky, you may need someone to help.  Loved the finished look and received so many compliments.

The compliment I got most on this dress was "that color is amazing." I got the dress as a quick replacement from customer service due to a problem with the dress I had initially ordered. (Customer Service with RTR is AMAZING by the way.) I had worn a dress by this designer before so I knew the size would work for my body. The fit was still a little loose, but overall very comfortable. Had quite a few people walk up and remark on how beautiful the color is. I'd definitely wear another dress by this designer again. Felt really very elegant in this dress. Loved it.
Awesome work dress! th So so flattering on any body type.  I can't wait to rent DVF wrap dresses in other colors!

Gorgeous dress and color, very sophisticated wowza of a dress! This dress is very comfortable, has a bit of stretch to the heavier material and is a gorgeous berry plum color. This dress accentuates your curves (will show rolls or extra stuff so a shapewear piece might be needed) in a good way and shows your cleavage if you have it. You will need to tape your "girls" since you can't wear a bra with the way the back is out. I am 5'6" and 148 lb with an athletic, curvy body and 34DD chest. I have trouble sometimes with my back being wide so I couldn't get the 6R zipped up completely. The sparkle waistband runs small so that's the area I was struggling to get the dress closed. I am going to rent one size up and this might be the dress!

amazing first anniversary dinner I am petite and normally cannot wear jumpsuits because the bodies are too long; I rented this one because reviewers said it ran short.  They were right!! The 0R fit perfectly everywhere except it was very very short in the crotch. The 2R fit better in the torso length, but was a little big everywhere else (especially the chest, the difference between the chest on the 0 and 2 was dramatic).  I wore the 2R because I wouldn't have been able to sit down in the 0R.  Definitely size up!!

Compliments all night long!  This dress has a thicker lining, so it was slightly sticky during a hot summer night. It bunched up near my thighs when I walked, but I was still able to dance all night long, and I don't think it looked bad. I received a ton of compliments on the dress and the color is truly stunning. I would wear this dress again!

A not so boring little black dress! Beautiful dress! Skirt feels like a thick satin-y material. Top has very pretty embroidery as well as other sparkly details. Dress definitely seemed to run large, I ordered size 2 and 4 and wore the 2, and even that was a little bit big.

This dress was as comfortable as it was beautiful!!  People came across the room to complement! The dress length runs a little on the shorter side. No problem- a 2" comfortable heel was in order for the night.

Beautiful, Amazing, Stunning Dress Loved this dress! The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is because I got a size 6 and 8, but was in between sizes. Other than that, the dress was perfect for my height (5'11") with 4 inch heels (6'3").

The color is amazing! Its also VERY flattering. I got tons of compliments all night. Spanx are necessary! While the material is forgiving, it also shows all your curves (good and bad).  I usually wear a 6... the 6 fit but was very tight. Also, if you have a larger chest like I do, the cut of the top looked like a sports bra in the smaller size. I went up to a size 8 and it was perfect!

Stunning! This dress was absolutely eye catching! It is a bright vibrant red with a great detailed bow.  The dress makes you like your wrapped in a pretty package. The compliments kept coming the entire night.  It was comfortable to dance and move in.  The black hanger straps do need to be taped down or they will come out.  I usually wear a 0 but this dress didnt come in a zero and wasnt as snug as I would prefer it to be at the top and slightly all over.  It does run a little longer but I am short and runs a little bit below the knee.  Perfect for a formal event.  I wore this to a retro red event.
Classy with an edge Size up!  Quality fabric holds its form.  Classy and classic cut with cutouts that ad an edge to the look.  It felt great to wear.

Simply beautiful! I have a soft spot for Marni and this top didn't disappoint. It's colorful and grabs attention, but it's very elegant and wearable. As others have mentioned, it runs a bit larger, but Marni clothes are usually cut to fit a little loose. I wore it with black wide leg trousers, with a black pencil skirt, with leather shorts, etc. If you're looking for a top, that's going to get you noticed, and that's going to make you feel fabulous, you can't go wrong with this piece!

Not for hourglass or pear shapes (unless you have a belt) This dress on its own gets 3 stars, or possibly less. It's not even slightly fitted in the waist, so it makes it look like your waist is as big as your hips and butt (which in my case is NOT desirable). Fortunately I had a thin belt that sits at my natural waist that I could wear that solved this issue and made it wearable and pretty cute. But without that, I never would have worn this dress in public. With the belt, I wore it to dinner in Manhattan and it was just right-- not too dressy and not too casual. I do wish the color were a bit more vibrant, though; the color was more subdued than it appeared on my screen.

perfect for a formal banquet, really easy to move in!  this dress was so comfortable and so easy to dance in! the slits on the sides are pretty deep so be ready to show some skin! overall this dress was perfect and I definitely didn't want to send it back :)
Added a small beige belt with this dress. It did wonders! It was a little tight in the bust area but that is my problem! lovely dress!

Fun dress to dance and party in The top of this dress is high cut, so even though it is sleeveless it was appropriate for a Catholic ceremony. I loved how the bottom was looser and flowed, super fun to dance in! I got my normal size 2 and also a size down (0) and both fit well. The 0 was a little more fitted, so I went with that size although the 2 looked just as good and had more room for eating delicious wedding cake.

Perfect LBD. Felt so sexy and never wanted to take it off  This dress hugged every curve on my body and made me feel so sexy. I am very flat chested and it actually made me look like I had some cleavage. The ruching also makes your butt look great. I also loved that I could wear a normal bra with it. It does run a little tight so be prepared for that if  you like your dresses to be somewhat loose fitting. I received so many compliments and was even told that I looked like a "James Bond girl."

Great fit, great color This dress was insane!! Loved it, got tons of compliments.  It is very plungy - but I have a small chest (34 B) and a little double stick tape was all I needed.  It was super comfortable and fit really well.  It was a little short - ankle length - so I wore it with flats.

Dramatic back and pretty lace Shockingly this dress may have been a little large for me; I had trouble getting it to fit snugly so that the back laid flat.  The back of this dress is dramatic and a striking contrast to the up to the neck lace.  Very sexy without being trashy.

Best dress I've ever worn Best dressed of the night!  I wore this dress to a black tie wedding in NY and everyone was obsessed with it.  I felt so glamorous!  The dress is super flattering and sexy without showing a ton of skin.  Would absolutely wear this dress again.  
I normally wear an 8 but decided to go with the 6 on this dress because the 8 was a bit large.  I'm 5'3 so the R wasn't too short for me to wear with heels, but I can see why taller ladies suggest ordering the L.

SEXY - but small.  This dress is the perfect way to feel sexy. It's snug, but not necessarily in a bad way. I've rented other dresses by this designer and wore the 14W with ease. This one was way too tight. I believe the 16W would have worked, but I just wore another dress instead. It gives gentle cleavage - which I was okay with. My boyfriend didn't like the sleeves, but he's nuts. This was a hot piece!

Best dress out of 120 gals! This dress was perfect! I ordered it for my roller derby league's formal end-of-season banquet. It is made of larger paillettes (the bigger sequins, however that is spelled), mostly in silver but also a few blue and red, and is stretchy. I ordered both the large and medium, assuming I'd wear the large, but I ended up using the medium since the large was actually sort of big in the armpit/bust area. I didn't have too much of a problem with it riding up or the sequins scratching my armpits or anything. Loved this dress and got a TON of compliments on it. I think it'd look good on almost anyone. It hugs curves well and hides and lumps, bumps, and tummy.

Amaze balls. got TONS of compliments and stood out from a sea of black/sequin dresses on NYE!  Runs VERY small. I normally wear a 4/6, but based on other reviews ordered 6 and 8 as backup. Ended up wearing the 8. The fit wasn't crazy different from the 6, but I legit couldn't lift my arms in the 6. I wanted to dance, so I thought the looser fit would be better. The bigger size too let me sort of adjust the texture of the dress, where I could style it to be more like a Nicole Miller dress with subtle ruching.  The hanging straps on it are kind of annoying, so just be ready to be on the lookout for them to pop out.

Confusing! I could not figure out how to get into this garment.  My boyfriend and I tried to figure out how I could possibly even try it on.  I am not sure if it fits or not simply because I didn't know how to possibly get in it.  It is a lovely color and a cool design, but I can't account for other information.

Beautiful dress. Lovely color.  Loved this dress. Beautiful color, great quality. Received many compliments on it. Only down side was it was a little big around the hips on me. For someone with narrow hips, consider a smaller size or different dress

Wore this dress for an opening night at 8 months pregnant! I'm usually a size 10, maybe 12 depending on the cut, in the Trina Turk dresses. But at 8 months pregnant this dress still fit and looked great. It is definitely short - I'm 5'0 and it was above my knee, but loose and dramatic and comfortable without feeling like a maternity dress.

Wore the dress for a black tie gala.  This dress is incredible. It is easy to wear and move while feeling elegant and effortless. I'm a 32G and the bust is support enough that I did not need a bra. With heels I was probably 5'11 for the evening and the long option brushed the floor perfectly.

Wore this to outdoor evening wedding, relaxed cocktail attire. The dress was perfect for the event. I loved the way the dress felt, and I received a lot of compliments on it.  The lace overlay was beautiful. I particularly liked that while the back appeared to be low cut, it was still high enough to wear a real (aka not strapless) bra.   

As other reviewers have pointed out the dress absolutely runs small - I am normally a 10, but based on comments I ordered a 12 and a 14.  The dress does not have any give, and it is as short as it looks in the picture. I ended up wearing the 14 for more room in the hips, and for the additional length as well. Regarding the color, the 12 was clearly navy but the 14 edged more toward royal blue. Both colors worked well with nude heels.

The neck was a little itchy.  The dress is a knockout.  You will love it.  Colors are so vibrant. The neck was a little itchy.  The dress is a knockout.  You will love it.  Colors are so vibrant and beautiful.

A classic! I rented this dress to wear to school. It's a classic piece. The dress is beautiful, chic, classy and comfortable. The lace is not itchy and the material is loose fitting and can be worn all day. I recommend this piece for taking your everyday wear up a notch. One might say that this piece would be too much for wearing to school, my response to that is, "dress like a boss, act like a boss, be treated like a boss!" I usually wear a size 00 in pants and I found I had some extra room in this dress, it just made it all the more comfortable!

This dress got so many compliments, even from strangers on the street. Beautiful details!  This dress was a little loose, even thou I am a busty gal. But the effect was great. The skirt flows when you walk, the fabric is great and lightweight.

Great Beach Cover-up Pretty colors and nice light weight fabric.  Although, wrinkles easy.  Wore this as a beach cover up on vacation.  I am usually a Medium/Small but when not fitted definitely a small so it does not look like a tent.

Many compliments at work from men and women This is a beautiful Aqua blue color sheath dress that fits like a glove giving shape in all the right places.  Fabric is stretchy making wearing at work very comfortable.  Added a jacket for the commute and cold conference rooms, but most of the day Inwas able to wear the dress without the jacket.  Comfy and classy, fits true to size.  I will recommend this dress for work absolutely.  You won't be disappointed
beautiful dress, tight arms I really loved the idea of this dress, but it was super tight in the arms so I didn't wear it. It fit great everywhere else!

Classic with a twist! Absolutely love this fun take on a classic and timeless wardrobe piece. You cannot go wrong with a tan, wool trench. The pink collar makes the coat! I am an unlimited member so I still have this piece. I have gotten more compliments on it! It is totally fun and worth the rental!

Perfect, figure-flattering dress! This was a lovely, comfortable dress--perfect for a long event. It was incredibly flattering (perfect placement of ruching and nipping at the waist) and I received compliments on it all night. I felt the fit was slightly large, but nothing ridiculous. I would recommend sizing down to maximize the hour glass effect!

That I am past 21 but at this 21st birthday party I was def wearing one of the hottest outfits! I went with the size 2 based on the heights given by other women and their weights and it fit perfectly. I got the 4 just in case but didn't need it. The reviews were right it fits comfy & is great for a night out partying!

Perfect summer dress! I'm normally a 6 and opted for the XS because I really wanted to try this dress but my size was never available. The XS actually ended up working great and was only a little tight in the boobs (36C). I think a small would have been better fitting in the bust but then would be too billowy in the bottom. It is so well made and the embroidery is just amazing! It was the perfect thickness of cotton so it wasn't too hot or too cold. I plan to buy it for next summer!

Gorgeous color, details, but long length makes dress unflattering. I'm 5'3, work out w/a trainer, in good shape (especially legs.)  This dress was way too long to be flattering; very matronly.  Very disappointed, since this was my #1 choice.  Fortunately I had a perfect Robert Rodriguez black lace shift as my back-up.
If I had the right size dress. Runs too small. pretty dress, runs 2 sizes too small

Beautiful  Got this through unlimited for a black tie wedding in the summer.  Love the cut and the dress.  I didnt keep it because its a bit warm for mu destination. Its very heavy.  But its gorgeous.

Super Fun and Chic! I'm only 5'1" and was concerned with the length but it was perfect.  Everyone loved my dress and complimented it all night long.  The lil sleeve gave it the fun detail that made it a little more dressy than normal.  Fabric had stretch and was super flattering.

Cute dress but does run a bit large.  I loved the color of this dress and that it was shiny but not so much to bring attention. I wore this for a fall wedding so it was fitting for the event. I did like the interior straps for your bra that other reviewers mentioned. I am petite (5'1" and 100 lbs) and normally wear a size 0. If a smaller size existed, it would've been perfect but it wasn't super obvious that the dress was roomy on top. The dress hit at a perfect length above my knees.

This  dress was perfection! The fit ran true to size and the red was gorgeous and vibrant ! I had compliments all night with this dress. I wore a regular length with normal stiletto heels and the length was great, I'm 5"3. The material has a little give to it  so it's very comfortable and easy to dance around in. I would definitely rent again!

Luxurious If I could wear this dress everyday for the rest of my life I would! Felt beautiful in the dress that fit perfectly. The blue is gorgeous and the gold fabric underneath shimmers in the sun. 

Wore this to a bridal shower wear I was the best dressed there HANDS DOWN. I could have and probably should have worn a different dress to the bridal shower. This dress was too special for that event.

The PERFECT dress for my Bachelorette Party! This dress was perfect for my bachelorette party!!! Comfortable, shiny, and bridal white! I said it runs true to size, but that's because I can range between a size 8-12, depending on the cut of the dress. For this dress, I wore an 8 and it fit my large breasts (36DD) perfectly! The only issue is the zipper. I knew that could be an issue, but luckily one of my friends used to work retail and knew the fix - you have to have one person pull the zipper taut from the top and the bottom and then have a second person zip it up. Once we did this, it zipped so easily!

Gorgeous dress!  I normally wear a 6, but the 8 fit much better. I also needed to use tape on the chest area so it didn't come open as I moved.  Overall- perfect dress for a holiday party. I received lots of compliments.

A classy and sexy gown - perfect for a formal event! This is a truly gorgeous dress. I wore this dress to my boyfriend's company holiday party and felt very confident and received so many compliments. The color is stunning, and the fit is extremely flattering! I especially love the slits, which provide a sexy touch and are great for showing off a nice pair of heels! The dress is quite comfortable, but it runs a little tight in the bust and hips, so I would recommend going up a size if you have wide hips and/or a large chest.
cute and simple but fun this dress is so cute and simple but has a hint of fun.  It fit tighter on my lower half than upper half.  overall, I thought it was very cute- but runs large

Professional Pop This is a great add on to dress-up an outfit. Able to wear with jeans or slacks. Since the jacket is a little bulky, I ordered a size down and it fit perfectly. It's a little stiff but overall enjoyed having it.
Perfect dress for an outdoor wedding unique and comfortable!  Great fit! Felt very comfortable all night!

This dress is so comfy and flattering! I wish I could keep it!  So flattering. I wore a medium R which ran true to size, but if planning to wear heals it was a little short. Great rental, wish I could keep it!

I felt like a super model! I loved this dress. I don't think the picture does it justice. I felt so special and I got so many compliments! I wore a broach and sparkly earrings. I was also just so impressed with RTR. My original dress was damaged so they sent me 4 options right away. Luckily this dress was in there. It was so comfortable, though the neck was a little tight, but nothing uncomfortable. I highly recommend this dress.

Beautiful, interesting, comfortable! I wore this as a bridesmaid in a wedding. The fabric was thick, so it smoothed out any lumps and bumps I had. I sized up from my regular size 4 because I didn't want to be bulging out of the cutouts, and it still fit well! I rented both the 6R and the 6L --- the 6R just skimmed the floor without heels (I'm 5'8), and the 6L allowed for 4 inch heels. The ONE con I would point out... since there are slits on both sides up the legs, the dress tended to gather and get caught between my legs when I walked.

Comfortable fabric, conservative with a hint of sexy librarian, collar and cuffs are antique-like Loved this dress.  Soft, stretchy neoprene-like fabric.  Skirt is not too short, but I wore black tights with it to avoid straying in the "sexy librarian" direction and staying more in the "work outfit" end of things.  The collar and cuffs are surprisingly antique in style, with an off-white and Victorian-style detailing.  At first it felt a bit costume-like, as if it was something I wasn't sure if I could "pull off".  But then I got used to it and really loved the dress.  I was giving a bunch of interviews that day at work, and several people told me they thought the dress was right on target for that.  But I also felt attractive it in!
Beautiful Details The fit is not very sexy. It was flowy and comfortable. I would suggest for a brunch or a casual daytime event.
Perfect party dress! I wore this for my Bachelorette party.  The dress is a snug fit, but it was flattering and comfortable all night.

Loved this dress! I was very impressed by the quality of the dress.  The silhouette made me feel extra feminine and flirty.  I loved the dress so much that I ended up buying it from another site online.  Can't wait to wear it again!

So Chic and Flattering; A Bit Shorter than Expected I rented this for a black tie event in Miami in late November -- so chic, so flattering, so elegant.  The neckline gives you a great opportunity to wear a major necklace.  I am a pretty true to size 8 and at 5'7", I thought either the 8R or 10R would be perfect -- but the 8R was way too short; the 10R was borderline too short but better.  Next time, I'd rent the 8L and it would probably be perfect.  Built in bra helps, but at 34 C I still needed a strapless bra for support.

Wasn't my first pick but the other dress I received was too big. RTR sent this and worked great!  Worked wonderful for the usmc ball I went to. Felt great all night. It was super comfortable and well made dress!
Great wedding with family This dress was so comfortable and easy to wear...loved it! Would rent it again!
Gorgeous unique dress. Flattering. Fits true to size. Gorgeous dress. Wore to speak at an event and received many compliments. Length and fit is professional but elegant.
Wore it to a black tie wedding and got tons of compliments. Plus it was really easy to dance in! Beautiful color with a super flattering fit. Loved loved loved it! Didn't want to return :)

Low cut summer dress Unfortunately didn't wear this out. I ordered as part of my unlimited subscription with the intention of wearing it to work. Unfortunately the top was way too low cut to make this work appropriate, and I'm not a fan of tanks under wrap dresses. Loved everything else about the dress.
True to size, great color, great length, comfortable. I wore this to an opera. It was very comfortable, loved the length, and I'm short but it still looked great. Ran true to size.

Wore this for the rehearsal dinner and received so many compliments! The fit is tight and the dress runs small. I'd suggest going a size up from what you normally wear. I normally wear a 0-2 depending on the style and with this one I wore a 2, i honestly could have probably gotten away with a 4. The color is AMAZING! The length is perfect because it isn't too long or too short. I am 5'8'' so I could imagine this being long on a shorter person.

I really liked this dress to just throw on for work! Loved the way this dress fit. True to size and easy to wear. The material is a little heavy, so good for work or an inside event! Paired it with a simple bar necklace and braid in my hair!

Great dress, just didn't end up wearing it. I got this as a backup dress because after an order that didn't work out I always have a backup style just in case.  This dress was great just not for me.  I am on the shorter side and it was a bit long for my taste.  It made me look shorter also.  My hair got caught on the sequins just when I tried it on for 5 minutes.   I would recommend an up do for this dress if you are renting.  Other than that it was comfortable but a little big overall.  It depends on how you like dresses to fit but I would size down when renting this because it does have a significant amount of stretch.

This dress is a showstopper and makes you want to show it off more than once!  The fabric is slightly stretchy, which is great if you want to throw your leg up for a group photo at the end of the night. Not everyone needs to be standing straight up with the same smile. I wore my back up size, which was a Large, my breasts needed the room, I am a 34DD. This dress is a little shorter than I originally thought, so make sure your legs are ready to be put on display! This dress has so much sparkle, I had to see it to believe it!

Cute pattern I wore this shirt to work, and I got a lot of compliments. The pattern is great - a little cheeky as they are lips but still professional. The top is large. I had to wear a cami underneath as the front button is quite low. I will rent again!
- Wore a 2, a 0 would have been perfect. Pretty dress. Conservative cut.

Fabulous quality, sexy dress but may need to size down! I loved this dress although it definitely runs a little big up top. I could have gone down to a 4, even though my usual size is an 8, especially as the skirt is so full. This would have allowed me to feel more secure in the bust since the dress is backless. The material is very thick and the bodice has good structure with some flexible boning so there was no exposure when going without a bra; however, there were times when I was dancing where I felt I could have used some more "holding in." I am 6 feet tall and the dress hit right at knee level for me so this is a perfect dress for taller ladies. One last note, the fabric itself was absolutely beautiful, unique, and gorgeous quality.

Spicing up a plain sweater! The vest is super soft and cozy. I am very short but even the XS was a bit too long for my height. I liked that it had a small clasp at the top so your under-layer can still show through when it's closed. My only complaint was the length, otherwise I'd definitely wear it again.

I loved the style of the dress, really flattering. Comfortable material. I fit into the dress but it was a little snug for me (sleeves, mostly) so if you're in between sizes, consider going up. LOVED the bottom of this dress. It's snug across your hips/butt, which also makes the flare at the bottom even more flattering. Loved this dress overall.

girlfriends and i loved it, husband hated it ha i'm typically a 4, got the XS after reading reviews, glad i did because it was still very oversized and boxy. wldve prob looked better even smaller so the shoulders would fit! i enjoyed the baby doll style, hit midthigh and worn with high black and white shoes. made a statement without being overly exposed. husband hated the boxy/baby doll look, girls loved it. just one of those things some ppl don't "get". that being said, i wld only recommend this to someone larger than a 4 and prob not too much taller than me unless you're comfortable showing A LOT of leg. i thoroughly enjoyed it and wld recommend!

classy but fun look I wore this dress to a formal charity gala.The pictures online do not do the dress justice. It is a really pretty dress with elegant touches shown in its details. It is also extremely comfortable and true-to-size so whatever you normally wear should fit. I highly recommend this dress to others for formal events, weddings, or a nice dinner date!

Casual sundress The dress is rather conservative with a high neckline, small arm holes, and somewhat loose shape. I found it a bit bulky and not especially flattering. It also was a little more casual than I expected for the wedding; it didn't seem expensive. I added a shiny belt to try to dress it up. It could easily be dressed down with a denim jacket and sandals for an everyday family function.

It’s a pretty dress but plungier than I realized and not as flattering as I would like. If you are a d cup, Undergarment is an issue.   Do not follow the suggestion for “nu bra” m that’s a total waste of money. No support and if you sweat they move.  Next time I would get a longline bra with a deep back. “Carnival  longline brand. “ google it.    I am a tall gal, 6’ and about 175. The be honest, I felt a bit large in it.  There are more flattering looks.

Absolutely loved this dress....so many compliments the entire night!
                 So the fit of the dress was great and it was rather comfortable...my only cons with the dress were that it was kinda short at the bottom and I'm a short chick, I'm only 5'3".....and the sequins ended up irritating the inside of my nails...I think from me grabbing at it when I was dancing....but I loved it! Perfect for a gala event!
Got rained on at an outdoor wine tasting and dried immediately! Tight on my arms and loose on my stomach and hips.

Great, Classy Dress... I wore this dress to a friend's wedding recently and I loved it. I worse the size 6 and it was flattering without being too form fitting. The right sleeve is a little shorter than the left laced sleeve so you can plan to wear a bracelet on that arm. I would definitely recommend this dress to anyone.
Stunning! This dress really is stunning! I received so many compliments at the wedding I attended. Rent it!

Rehearsal dinner in Boulder, CO Ordered a 6 & an 8 - I'm typically an 8 but for this dress, I went with the 6 & it felt perfect. I received so many compliments on this dress. It's great for flattering shoulders & arms.  The pattern is summery and summer and interesting. I think this would be formal enough for a summer wedding, although I wore it to the rehearsal dinner the evening before. The material is a little heavy for being outside in the hot sun. The pockets are an extra bonus!

Gorgeous fit, but the bottom is not finished like in the picture I loved the dress overall, it's true to size and beautiful. I rented this using unlimited for aa dress that is coming up so i am going to order a long and wear heals in hopes that dress is better. This one looked like it had been hacked off at the bottom instead of preserving the scallop hem that is pictured on the website.  I get that it's hard to shorten things but there are ways of preserving hems and normally it seems like RTR does that. Definitely disappointing but still a nice dress.

Great dress! Really liked this dress and received a lot of compliments! I usually wear a 6 but wore a 4 in this dress. I got a size 6 and 4 delivered and they both fit in the middle but the 6 was a little big in the shoulders. It was very comfortable and the shoulders stayed in place which was good. Good pick!
Great Lilly Perfect for a hot day - super lightweight, comfortable, and easy to wear.

Beautiful sequin ensemble - good for winter parties, but size up! I didn't end up wearing this dress. RTR sent it to me since the backup size in my other dress was not available. It was beautiful in person - it's all sequins! However, the small was too small, and it was hard to get on without getting scratched up. The fabric is not forgiving due to the sequins, so I would recommend sizing up!

Great for a summer wedding! Loved the color! Got lots of compliments. It did fit a snug through ribcage and chest. I was not able to wear a bra. And with a larger chest, I was worried about that. But the dress held me in pretty well and wasn't too revealing.

I wore this skirt to a play. It was fun/playful and perfect for the event.  The only reason I didn't give it 5 stars was because the material stuck together at the bottom and made it seem like it was bunching together. Otherwise it was great.

Awkward fit for the bigger chested... This dress looks adorable on the model here but it sits very differently if you have a larger chest.  The stripes on the sleeves are at a different angle than those on the dress and where the sleeves attach to the main portion of the dress is not the normal cut.  Overall, it was just ill-fitting and unflattering.  I tried to belt it to see if it would look better but it was just as awkward fitting.

Fantastic, fun dress! I loved this dress- i got so many compliments on the color! The sleeves were great, not as big as they appear in the stock photo- very flattering, especially if you're self conscience of your arms like i am. The dress fit a bit snugger through the waist and the hips, so i went a size up as this was a family wedding.

This dress is classic glamor!!  It is both sexy and elegant. I'm 5'2", so I was nervous about wearing a long dress, but I was able to gather the fabric at my waist enough to make it the perfect length.  The fabric has some stretch, so it was very fitted but still comfortable. The neckline was constantly flipping out, which was the only thing I didn't completely love about this dress. I thought I could hold it in place with wardrobe tape, but it didn't work.

The dress was gorgeous and comfortable! I rented this dress for a March Wedding. It was comfortable enough to dance all night and has cups that were actually functional so I didn't need to manufacture any sort of bra. It's a very dark Navy color. I got plenty of compliments. I did have to wear the size 2, although I'm normally a 0.

I got a ton of compliments in this dress! Being a 36DDD, I was a little self conscious about the amount of cleavage I had on display. This probably would have been perfect for a C or D cup. However, I felt so secure in this dress that I didn't wear a strapless bra. I danced the entire night and never had to adjust! The inner lining of the skirt is made of a soft jersey that is ~ 6 inches shorter than the outer tulle layers, which is nice so you're both comfortable and don't have to worry about tripping over the skirt.
Elegant and vibrant Loved the vibrant color of this dress! I am 5'1 and the 2P fit perfectly. Wore this to a formal summer wedding. I love that this dress comes in Petite sizes!
Great dress for my bridal shower! I wore this dress  to my bridal shower and absolutely loved it! I got so many compliments and felt comfortable in it all day. Would definitely rent it again!!!
I felt totally stylish! The inner fabric was stretchy so it fits like a glove. Great dress for a black tie wedding!!!

I received many compliments! I wore my hair up with layering gold jewelry & nude sandal with 4"heel. This dress runs large. I am 34C and usually wear size 4 in dresses. The arm holes were too large for me on the 4 and I had to wear a navy bra to make sure it wasn't noticeable, but the cape/sleeve also helped conceal. I still liked the overall fit of the dress (better than the 2). I am curvy. If you are an athletic build, the size 2 would probably fit you better. Sorry no pictures. I forgot to take one before I left.
Lux rock I definitely hope to rent this moto jacket again.  It's high quality leather, so you can pair it with a gown for a formal affair.  Rock on!

Worn to a military ball, and was perfect for the occasion!  I LOVED this dress and received so many compliments! I wore a size smaller than what I usually wear since it is very fitted.  I'm 5'6" and got a long, and it was the perfect length to wear with heels, but would've been too long for flat shoes.  Very flattering, and the cutout is in the perfect spot!

New Years - easy to move in and complimented all the right areas!  Awesome dress - fits like a glove - I suggest sizing up I am normally a 4/6 and based on previous reviews I went 6 and 8 for my rental and but the 8 was definitely the way to go for me especially with the slit I didn't want it any tighter through my thighs.  It is a great color and neckline - super comfortable. Definitely dont HAVE to wear a bra unless you are more comfortable in one like myself - it was new years eve and freezing out so I opted for one just to be safe. Certainly would rent this dress again!
It was a fun family wedding. The dress is very attractive and comfortable.  The side zippier was difficult to zip up but easy to unzip.  I got a ton of compliments.

Felt sexy and sleek The deep v and cut out details on the side exposed some skin but did so in a tasteful way which I liked. I wore a 0R which size wise worked great. Even though it was a bodycon style I had plenty of breathing room.. However, I wish I had ordered it  in the long size. With my height of 5’7” and the 3” heels I wore it was too short. Tall girls take note! If you’re bigger in the bust this might not be your style as it is not feasible to wear a well supporting bra. This dress is best with a Nu bra or with fashion tape. I would recommend sizing up for the backup size. It supposed to fit snug but if hips are your problem area then one up might be best! Wow the crowd and your date in this dress for a black-tie wedding or fancy formal this season.

Cute jacket  It wasn't quite the wow jacket I was hoping for but it was very nice. Comfy to wear. I didn't close it cus the knit fabric isn't very forgiving when closed on my curves. It was cute though. I sized up.

This was such a fantastic jumpsuit for my 25th birthday - made me feel like a star! There is almost no give on the jumpsuit, I am usually a size 4 and wore the Medium.  The band part around the waist makes it hard to zip up without help, along with the button clasps on top.  Recommend going without a bra as the structure is very supportive on its own.

So pretty! I really like this romper. Typically I wear a small, but I've been waiting to rent this for a while so I finally just ordered the medium. It was a little big, but it was still really cute. The fabric is nice because it's a little thicker, without being heavy or hot. I really liked that it was kind of short, but had ruffles so I didn't feel self conscience. This is a great romper and I recommend it 100000%

Stylist Review This dress is perfect for a transitional item from work to a dinner or company party! The Sugar Beet Caley Dress is true to size providing some stretch. The bust and waist are fitted to accentuate your figure with a loose fit in the hip area. The color will compliment any skin tone and will be paired best with beige or black heels.

So much fun! This skirt was just fun. I tend to wear longer more fitted skirts and this was the first time I went with one this style. I paired it with a fitted black top and some white pearl jewelry. I wore it to a dinner with some friends. It was cute and just fun. I don't think I could get away with this for work though. Just one thing to note, the dots on the dress are not really white. They are an off white.
